test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Although she is usually / rude with everyone, / she behaved nice / with all of us today.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. she behaved nice .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word **"nice"** is incorrectly used as it is an adjective. The correct form is to use an adverb **"nicely"** to describe the verb *behaved*.
 
• An adverb is required to modify a verb, and the word *behaved* is a verb in this sentence.
 
• The corrected segment should be: **"she behaved nicely"**.

Correct sentence: *Although she is usually rude with everyone, she behaved **nicely** with all of us today*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjectives vs. Adverbs:**
 
 
• **Adjectives:** Describe nouns or pronouns (e.g., nice, beautiful).
 
• **Adverbs:** Describe verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs (e.g., nicely, beautifully).
 
• **Rule:** When describing how an action is performed, use an adverb.
